items.example: He pretended to be a doctor on a ship during the war.
An impostor is someone who pretends to be someone else to trick people.
He cured their illnesses and pulled out bad teeth.
The police caught him and he spent six months in prison.
Later the police arrested him for a different crime.
He appeared in a 1960 film to make some money.

items.idiom: make a film of someone's life
items.example: Hollywood made a film of Demara's life in 1961.
